# Synthetic fixtures

Data generated from a reference implementation, not captured from an installation.

| File | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `casefold-vectors.json` | Python's `str.casefold()`, generated by `scripts/gen-case-fold.py` with the Python Home Assistant 2026.11.2 requires (3.14.2 or later); the header fields give the exact Python and `unicodedata` versions, the date and the command | Every code point that `casefold()` changes, with its output. Generated together with `src/domain/text/case-fold-table.ts`; both are excluded from Biome so regeneration gives a clean diff. Regenerate when Home Assistant's required Python moves to a newer Unicode version |
